channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Film & Video, EU, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Film & Video, EU, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 03 Aug 2026 (03 Aug to 09 Aug 2026).

  • RTM Pitch 2026 (IFFR)
    International Film Festival Rotterdam (IFFR) · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · EUR 25,000 for the winner (EUR 20,000 from the City of Rotterdam, EUR 5,000 from VEVAM Fonds) to realise the film, plus tailored coaching and an IFFR premier...
